opus_run.failure_root_cause: OpenRouter 402: CLI requests max_tokens=128000 (model max_completion_tokens); OpenRouter reserves 128000 * $0.00002 = $2.56 against account remaining before the request. After 8 PRs account remaining fell below $2.56, so PRs 9-16 were rejected with 'API Error: 402 This request requires more credits, or fewer max_tokens... can only afford ~114k'. Records show is_error=true, exit_code=1, structured_output missing, zero tokens used. This is a billing/reservation failure, not a quality failure.
opus_run.fix_verified: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=16000 caps the CLI request max_tokens (CLI reads this env var; verified in CLI binary and by test run). Diagnostic tag r2_opus_test_dify11 on dify#11 with this env var: schema-valid 1/1, F1 0.667 (tp3 fp0 fn3), cost $0.2438, no cost flags. Fix was verified AFTER the main run; main-run records were not re-run with it because remaining budget ($1.1682) cannot cover the 7 remaining PRs (~$1.96 projected).
opus_run.partial_run_warning: Opus micro F1 0.320 is computed over all 16 PRs with 8 failed PRs scoring F1 0. It is a lower bound biased downward by billing failures, not a clean quality estimate. On the 8 valid PRs opus precision was high (0.667 overall) but recall low (0.211 overall, dragged by zeros).
